race.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Apprentice Handicap
race.verdict: MEHMAR only just failed to justify sustained support starting out for his new yard when second at Southwell 31 days ago, splitting a pair of next-time-out winners in the process. He remains very well handicapped on the back of 4 lb rise based on past exploits and rates a major player from a handy draw. Black Missile also arrives on the back of a solid effort and is next best, whilst Knicks has the ability to play a part if putting it all together, too. MEHMAR (IRE) BLACK MISSILE (IRE) KNICKS (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Mehmar (10/3), Black Missile (4/1), Daytona Lady (5/1), Knicks (7/1), Havana Club (8/1), Megaphone (10/1), Forever Glamorous (10/1), Act Of Violence (12/1), Diligent Henry (20/1), Mister Moet (25/1), Papa Don't Preach (25/1), Goldenstateofmind (33/1), Devil's Angel (50/1)
